# HELIX ONE (12 · helix)

An audio sculpture in real-time 3D — drag it, scroll-choreographed camera, live finish configurator.

- **Technique:** THREE.JS
- **Tags:** product, 3d, three.js, hardware, audio, premium, tech, configurator
- **Best for:** hardware launches; audio products; consumer electronics
- **Fonts:** Michroma, Instrument Sans
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Michroma&family=Instrument+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #101113 · #c9ced6 · #e8a33d
- **Dependencies:** `three` (npm)
- **Source:** `src/templates/helix/` (Template.astro, content.ts, meta.ts, stage.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* helix — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --coal: #101113;
  --coal2: #16181b;
  --panel: color-mix(in srgb, var(--coal2) 72%, transparent);
  --chrome: #c9ced6;
  --amber: #e8a33d;
  --tx: #eceef1;
  --dim: #9aa2ad;
  --faint: #565d68;
  --scroll-thumb: #24272c;
  /* 3D scene: pedestal disc and ambient light */
  --pedestal: #191b1e;
  --ambient: #404550;
  --disp: "Michroma", sans-serif;
  --body: "Instrument Sans", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `stage.ts`
  - `initStage(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, finishes: FinishSpec[])` — The HELIX sculpture: a drag-to-rotate helical tube on a pedestal, with a scroll-choreographed camera and tweened finish changes. Scene colors come from the `--coal`, `--amber`, `--pedestal` and `--ambient` tokens.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<span>/<a> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** A machined finish: drives both the swatch button and the live 3D material. */
export interface Finish {
  /** Unique key (button `data-fin`). The first finish is the default. */
  id: string;
  /** Label under the swatch. */
  name: string;
  /** CSS `background` for the round swatch dot (color or gradient). */
  dot: string;
  /** Base metal color of the 3D model (any CSS color). */
  color: string;
  metalness: number;
  roughness: number;
  /** Color of the glowing core line inside the helix. Defaults to the `--amber` token. */
  accent?: string;
}

export interface SpecRow {
  label: string;
  /** Value; may contain `<i>` for accent-colored fragments. */
  valueHtml: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in the nav and footer; wrap the accented separator in `<span>`. */
  brandHtml: string;
  /** Nav links before the call-to-action pill. */
  nav: Link[];
  /** Pill-shaped nav call to action. */
  navCta: Link;
  /** Accessible description of the 3D canvas. */
  stageLabel: string;
  hero: {
    /** Anchor id of the hero section. */
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    title: string;
    sub: string;
    cta: Link;
    price: string;
    /** Small line under the price. */
    priceNote: string;
    /** Hint at the bottom of the hero (desktop only). */
    scrollCue: string;
  };
  design: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    bodyHtml: string;
    specs: SpecRow[];
  };
  finishes: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    body: string;
    /** Accessible label of the swatch group. */
    groupLabel: string;
    options: Finish[];
  };
  preorder: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    body: string;
    cta: Link;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    /** Credit line; the showcase line is appended on showcase routes. */
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```
